mapper.sql: id, mode_id, version_no, system_prompt, validation_profile, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.mode_id, v.version_no, v.system_prompt, v.validation_profile, v.created_at FROM ai_transform_mode_versions v INNER JOIN ai_transform_modes m ON m.id = v.mode_id AND m.current_version = v.version_no WHERE v.mode_id = #{modeId}
SELECT FROM ai_transform_mode_versions WHERE mode_id = #{modeId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_transform_mode_versions (mode_id, version_no, system_prompt, validation_profile) VALUES (#{modeId}, #{versionNo}, #{systemPrompt}, #{validationProfile})
